name: single-container-fullstack
description: Single Docker container for fullstack monorepo (Next.js + FastAPI)

rules.message: Dockerfile uses multi-stage build: Node.js builds Next.js, Python runs FastAPI on port 8000. Next.js output available at /app/public/.next
PostgreSQL 18 stores its volume at /var/lib/postgresql; migrate PostgreSQL 16 data before reusing an existing volume.
